parsed.answer: No past ticket reports this problem, so treat it as a new issue. The closest tickets (PowerToys#47250, #32650, #38738, #31764) show the same duplicated 'Detected related bundle' lines in the Burn log. But they are about a different failure: the cross-scope bundle condition (0x81f40001, 'already installed') blocking install or uninstall. None of them show the duplicate planned uninstall failing with 0x80070003 after the first uninstall removed the cache, or an upgrade reporting success while leaving a broken Installed Apps entry. Your analysis of the duplicate per-user bundle scan (wixtoolset/issues#7675) is not covered by any archived ticket, so the Burn fix suggestion is yours to propose in this ticket. For the stale entries, the only related guidance in the archive is from #31764. There, extracting the MSI from the matching per-user installer, using the instructions at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/powertoys/install#extracting-the-msi-from-the-bundle, and uninstalling with it let the user remove the old install. That ticket's cause was different, so it may not work for your case. Keep your logs attached to this ticket.
